newsitem.title: UK: BFI up five as Panamax availability tightens.
newsitem.headline: BFI up five as Panamax availability tightens.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up five to 1,262 points on Thursday and brokers said the shortage of early Panamaxes in the Atlantic was the principal positive feature for owners.
Market talk suggested $21.00 no combo may have been paid for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for June loading following Halla's overnight fixture $20.50 no combo.
Egyptian charterers are said to have conceded higher timecharter rates for Panamaxes from US East Coast and US Gulf for redelivery Egyptian Med in one case and Passero in another.
Caper rates have eased in the Atlantic and large craned bulker rates from the Continent to the Far East were also weaker.
The Baltic Handy Index dropped six points to 1,026 points.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was trading at 5 five points higher to unchanged and turnover totalled 15 lots.
